_comment: Template — replace YOUR_* placeholders before importing into openclaw. Schedule: every 4 hours.
name: NR Document Watcher

payload.message:
## STEP 0: Beads task tracking (MANDATORY — do this FIRST before anything else) Run these exact commands: ``` BEADS_ACTOR=openclaw bd create --title="NR Document Watcher $(date +%Y-%m-%d)" --description="Poll NextRequest for new public records docs, analyze, send Telegram follow-up" --type=task --priority=3 > /tmp/bd_issue.txt 2>/dev/null ISSUE=$(grep "Created issue:" /tmp/bd_issue.txt | grep -oE "[a-zA-Z]+-[a-z0-9]+" | head -n 1 || echo "") echo "BEADS_ISSUE=$ISSUE" [ -n "$ISSUE" ] && BEADS_ACTOR=openclaw bd update "$ISSUE" --claim 2>/dev/null && echo "Claimed $ISSUE" ``` Save the ISSUE value (e.g. HOME-abc). You will close it at the end. --- Run the NR document watcher, then analyze any new docs and send a follow-up Telegram message. STEP 1 — Run the orchestrator: python3 YOUR_RECORDS_MONITOR_PATH/nr-orchestrator.py 2>&1 The orchestrator polls NextRequest for new public records documents, downloads them, uploads to Drive, sends a notification Telegram, and writes /tmp/nr-new-docs.json with the results. STEP 2 — Check /tmp/nr-new-docs.json: cat /tmp/nr-new-docs.json If new_docs array is empty: Close beads issue: BEADS_ACTOR=openclaw bd close "$ISSUE" --reason="NR watcher: no new docs" 2>/dev/null Then stop here (NO_REPLY). STEP 3 — For each unique PRR that has new docs: a) Extract text from each PDF: pdftotext "" - 2>/dev/null | head -400 (use local_path from the JSON; if pdftotext fails, note the filename only) b) Read the "subject" field — this is what was originally requested c) Analyze: - What time period does this release cover? - What doc types were provided (reports, emails, contracts, invoices)? - What is in each doc vs. what the subject says was requested? - Are there obvious gaps? (time gaps, missing doc types, redacted pages, boilerplate non-responses) d) If gaps exist: draft a deficiency/follow-up letter STEP 4 — Send the analysis via Telegram (one message per PRR): curl -s -X POST "https://api.telegram.org/bot${TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN}/sendMessage" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d "{\"chat_id\":\"${TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID}\",\"text\":\"\",\"parse_mode\":\"HTML\"}" Format the message as HTML: 🔍 Analysis: PRR {pid} ({dept}) Requested: {subject} Received: {N} doc(s) — {date} Content summary: {1-2 lines per doc: title/filename, date range if present, key topics} Gap analysis: {specific gaps: missing years, doc types not produced, redacted sections} If no gaps: ✅ Release appears complete Recommended action: {send deficiency letter | no action needed} If deficiency letter recommended, append: 
Via NextRequest Portal — PRR {pid}

Dear Records Custodian,

I am writing regarding my CPRA request #{pid} submitted to {dept}. The request sought: {subject}.

On {date}, you released {N} document(s). The release is incomplete because:

{numbered list of specific deficiencies}

Under Gov. Code § 7920 et seq., please produce the missing records within 14 days, or provide written exemption citations for any withheld records.

YOUR_NAME
Keep the full message under 4000 characters. If too long, truncate at 3800 chars. ## FINAL STEP: Close beads issue After sending all messages (or if stopping early), run: ``` BEADS_ACTOR=openclaw bd close "$ISSUE" --reason="NR watcher done: new docs analyzed" 2>/dev/null ```
